name: getfortrip-platform
description: getfortrip Global OTA Platform (Nuxt 3 SPA + Vue 3 Admin + Go API)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend-user install && npm --prefix frontend-user run generate
scripts.build:user: npm --prefix frontend-user install && npm --prefix frontend-user run generate
scripts.build:admin: cd frontend-admin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:admin && npm run build:user && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend-admin/dist', 'frontend-user/.output/public/admin', {recursive:true});"
